# My Dotfiles

The configurations and tools I use for all purposes, on macOS/Linux/Windows.

- Uses [Chezmoi](https://www.chezmoi.io/) for fast, scalable, cross-platform support.
- Uses [Nix](https://nixos.org/) for declarative and reproducible packages across multiple platforms.

## Additional Notes

### Windows

- Highly recommend if you are able that you use [Chris Titus's Windows Utility](https://github.com/christitustech/winutil) for all things debloating and system configutions.
- For most development tasks you should try to be behind WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux).
- For packages that aren't behind WSL (or not available with WinGet) but semi-ephemeral (i.e. you might uninstall this later) I really like [Scoop](https://scoop.sh/). I would put all packages as possible through this, but the way it installs packages is not consistent with being reproducible on machines where Scoop isn't really being used.
